title: When the Debt Turns
author: I. M. Eriksen
blurb: Edmund Reyes, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
